notes: Summary: enterprise defense contractor with strict air-gapped on-prem requirement. Cannot accept any outbound control plane or persistent network egress from inference hosts.
Initial interest: generative search + internal support agent for classified docs; heavy focus on reranking for operational logs.
Call 2024-02-12 (intro): AE Maya Chen + SE Jordan Patel. Customer emphasized 'must be physically isolated, no cloud connectivity.'
Technical deep-dive 2024-03-14: security team requested offline installer, FIPS-cert HSM path, and checkboxed attestation for rebuilds. Asked for proof-of-concept entirely air-gapped.
Security review notes: red flags on Redwood hosted control plane callbacks and telemetry. Asked for option where control plane can be fully air-gapped and local KMS only.

Product response: Redwood Private supports VPC and customer-managed control plane but full appliance-style air-gap + on-site install not available off-the-shelf. Roadmap item discussed (timeline multi-quarter).
POC ask: Novus wanted a 3-week on-prem POC with their HSM and no egress. We proposed an accelerated partner engagement but couldn't commit to delivery within customer deadline.
Procurement update 2024-05-22: budget hold announced pending org-level compliance audit; internal champion (Head of ML Ops) left the company in re-org — momentum dropped.
Competitive pressure: OnyxServe proposed appliance that meets strict air-gap + on-site installation and long-term maintenance; lower near-term integration risk for Novus security team.

Final status: Procurement awarded to OnyxServe (closed-lost). Reason: immediate air-gapped appliance requirement + timeline and security sign-off. Customer may revisit in 12-18 months if internal policy shifts.
Quotes from customer: 'We can't take any risk of outbound telemetry — our auditors will not sign off unless it's physically isolated.'
Lessons: document exact technical gaps (installer, HSM binding, no-control-plane option) and build clearer partner/appliance play for future air-gapped opportunities.
